output_list.reason: The 'mint' function has an integer overflow that allows the presale contract owner to set the balance of any user to a large value.
The 'buyTokens' function has an integer overflow in the token amount calculation, allowing the price to be set to a very high value, aka 'gofei' attack.
The 'withdrawFunds' function uses 'transfer' to send funds, which is vulnerable to a time attack, allowing incorrect balances and unusable funds.
